web_fixture.title: Shipping label API v1 sunset - Steepholm
web_fixture.snippet: Production keys keep working for 150 days after the notice, then the v1 label endpoints are switched off.
web_fixture.content:
# Shipping label API v1 sunset

Steepholm, 2 February 2026.

The v1 label endpoints stop accepting production keys 150 days after the date
of this notice. Until that day they behave as they do today; from that day the
endpoints are switched off and every request is refused.

The v2 label endpoints are the replacement and take the same address fields.
This notice does not cover sandbox keys, which run to their own schedule.

web_fixture.title: Sandbox key notice - Steepholm
web_fixture.snippet: Sandbox keys are switched off 30 days after the notice date.
web_fixture.content:
# Sandbox key notice

Steepholm, 2 February 2026.

Sandbox keys are switched off 30 days after the date of this notice. Label
files built with a sandbox key after that day are refused, whatever endpoint
they are sent to.

turns.prompt: Our despatch desk prints labels with a production Steepholm key and the v1 label endpoints are being retired. For how many days after the sunset notice do production keys keep working? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
